opening.rule: Preserve original M7 audio/visual/candidate SRT hashes; any actual final composition offset is derived only from verified real asset boundaries

claims.validation: canonical Claim ID ordered sequence across on-screen display, source-backed voice text and full Arabic subtitle text, with deterministic oral dates/numerals and punctuation-based cues; reject missing, reorder, unsupported news causality, broker/institution confusion, fabricated unit
claims.time_rule: srt boundaries from actual evidence with timing grade; estimated timing never labeled acoustic sync

vtuber.place: M7 original protected bottom-right area [1440,380,1880,940] at 1920x1080
vtuber.future_measurement: Real voice-to-mouth/frame evidence; sample at transitions, silence and rapid phoneme changes; examine 1080p sharpness with actual decoded frames

safe_zones.future_cc_on_off: At full HD plus at least one mobile player viewport inspect cue at first, longest, transitions and closing; capture time/player/viewport screenshot evidence; reject any overlap with progress bar, CC reminder, scene counter or presenter

progress.rule: Never treat M7 opening length as complete final duration; no invented timestamps

retry.on_failure: Read completed validated artifact manifest before deciding which failed stage can resume; upload-only failure uses existing verified MP4/SRT/thumbnail and must not regenerate media
retry.idempotency: Upload reference and stage completion must be recorded; do not duplicate private videos on retry
retry.gates: Actual future private YouTube upload requires separate explicit permission, secrets availability and all prior independent acceptance, never inferred from this spec
retry.thumbnail_403: May be deferred with explicit record; do not recreate MP4
